prompts.core:
Create a professionally authored 2D game pixel-art sprite sheet for OLGA GURLUKOVICH in her MGS2 SONS OF LIBERTY TANKER boss fight uniform. Faithful canonical character from 2007 Tanker chapter, not her Plant chapter and not ninja MrX. Original fan-game adaptation, not copied key art. References: Yoji Shinkawa official interview https://www.konami.com/mg/archive/mgs2/art/third.html explicitly the Russian striped shirt; Konami official MGS2 character manual https://metalgear.konami.net/manual/mc1/mgs2/xbox/en/page24.html ; Tanker navigation deck battle. Adult fit fair-skinned Russian female soldier, very short cropped platinum-blonde military hair, angular face, faint cheek scar, serious expression. White and dark navy HORIZONTAL STRIPED sleeveless tank top (Russian telnyashka) under olive tactical shoulder harness with small pouches, broad bare upper arms, camouflage green/brown baggy military trousers, practical dark brown combat boots, belt with holster. No longhair, no cap, no eyewear, no ninja suit, no full-sleeve Plant camouflagejacket. Holds a compact dark USP semi-automatic PISTOL with small underbarrel light, NOT a rifle or revolver. Believable natural adult proportions, not sexy pinup, not chibi.
Composition: EXACTLY4columns×4rows,16fullbodyposes, same strict side-view facingRIGHT throughout, equal squarecells, constant character scale with height70%cellheight and feetbaseline85%height. Square overallcanvas. Flat pure magenta #ff00ff everywhereoutsidefigure, thin cyan #00ffff grid exactly5vertical5horizontal onquarterboundariesincludingborder. Atleast20pxmagenta paddinginsideeachcell; hands/gun/boots cannot touchguides. No text/labels/logos/ground/shadows/landscape, no rain FX bakedin. Crisp detailed pixelart clusters and restrained PS2-era faithful palette, dark readable outlines, no 3D rendering.
Rows are4successive coherent animation phases, not unrelatedposes:
ROW1 IDLE lowready pistol by front hip, subtlebreathing/hand grip/weightshift.
ROW2 MOVE four anatomically distinct tactical run cycle phases toright: frontcontact, compression, oppositefootpass, oppositecontact; torsoleansforward pistolheldclose safely.
ROW3 CHARGE means AIM not energy: raise pistol onehand into two-handed aim, shouldersquare, sightssteady, fullaim. No muzzleflash untilnextrow. No magic, no beam.
ROW4 ATTACK controlled pistol firing, fourphases: aimed squeeze, compact yelloworange muzzleflash, visiblewrist/pistolrecoil, sightsrecover. Weapon/barrel always pointsRIGHT. Eachcellcompletefullbody, consistent facehairstripedshirt/outfit acrossall16cells. A normal human who aims/shoots, not a machine.
